key.name: debug
key.description: Whether the extension should print debug information to the journal.

key.name: blacklisted-wm-classes
key.description:
WM_CLASS values ignored by the extension.
Supported patterns: - exact: example - prefix: example* - suffix: *example - contains: *example*

key.name: auto-sync
key.description: Sync 5 minutes (not configurable for now) after desktop entries change (debounced), when the original icon or name changed (same mechanism as sync button).
